name: Traveler's Hook
description: The Traveler's Hook is a compact, low-profile tool designed to manipulate latches that have a small amount of travel or gap exposure. It is effective on doors where the latch can be partially accessed through the door gap and is a fast, covert option for initial latch bypass on lighter commercial hardware. Its small form factor makes it an ideal EDC bypass tool when profile and weight are priorities.

blue.det: Time at door with tool; door open alert; camera footage.
blue.cm: Latch guards preventing access to latch bolt; door alarms; anti-shimming latch bolts; camera coverage of entry points.
